current_logic.universe_selection: CS_RANK 필터링 (16-32 symbols). Anchor/Macro/Screener 3-tier 구조 유지.
current_logic.regime_classification: [V9.0 3-Layer Hierarchical] Architectural shift from single-model HMM to hierarchical decomposition. Layer 1 (MS-GARCH, 12h): Vol Regime (3-state: LOW_VOL/MID_VOL/HIGH_VOL) with skew-t innovations. Layer 2 (Direction HMM, 6h): Direction signal (3-state: BULL/RANGE/BEAR) conditional on vol regime. Layer 3 (Rules): Crisis detector (5-rule soft scoring) overrides outputs when crisis_prob>=0.25. Final 5-state semantic output via cross-product mapping.
current_logic.alpha_generation: LightGBM v6 (DART + Dynamic Labeling). OOS IC=0.0743, T-Stat=33.27. [Unchanged from v8.2]
current_logic.signal_combination: signal_composer.py: Linear combination with HMM regime multiplier. Risk multiplier centered at 1.0 (1.0 - 0.75*p_crisis - 0.4*p_bear + 0.2*p_bull). [Unchanged from v8.2]
current_logic.optimization: 3-Phase Coordinate Ascent (A:80, B:120, C:60). Objective: median(log_TW) - 1.0*MAD - 0.5*DD_max. [Unchanged]
current_logic.validation: AWF K=6 legs, IS-pool=70%, timeframe-aware embargo. [Unchanged]
current_logic.risk_management: HMM Modulator v9.0: Hierarchical regime with proper vol clustering (MS-GARCH). CRISIS MU finally negative (-0.144%), eliminating V-bounce contamination. Crisis detector with forward-looking rules enables preventive protection.

key_parameters.layer1_model: MS-GARCH with skew-t innovations. Per-state params: (ω, α, β, ν, λ). TVTP on 3 features: cs_dispersion, funding_mom, oi_delta.
key_parameters.layer1_metrics: CRISIS MU target: <-0.2%, BEAR MU: <0.0%, vol_high share: 5~15%
key_parameters.layer2_model: Gaussian HMM on vol-normalized returns. States: BULL (μ>0), RANGE (μ~0), BEAR (μ<0). Conditional on layer1 vol state.
key_parameters.layer2_metrics: Direction stability and lead-lag accuracy vs fwd returns
key_parameters.layer3_model: Rules-based crisis detector: 6 soft rules (4-sigma, liq proxy, funding extreme, vol_high+bear, 3-sigma, vol_high transition). Threshold: crisis_prob >= 0.25. Overrides regime outputs.
key_parameters.output_mapping: 6 internal states (3 vol × 3 dir) → 5 semantic states (bull_calm, bull_vol_up, bear_trend, chop, crisis) via cross-product + crisis override.
key_parameters.hmm_min_duration: No longer fixed per-state. Regime-appropriate via natural HMM persistence.

architectural_insights.breakthrough: First time CRISIS MU achieved negative value (-0.144%) across all v8.x and v9.0 experiments. Root cause addressed: V-shaped recovery problem solved by decomposing vol regime from direction regime.
architectural_insights.key_lesson: Unsupervised clustering (Student-t HMM) cannot solve supervised classification (investment regimes). Architectural decomposition + supervised crisis detector is the correct approach.
architectural_insights.remaining_frontier: Lead-Lag Tail Capture measurement + Regime Information Coefficient (IC). Current concurrent tail capture doesn't measure preventive power.

failed_experiments.lesson: Adding more distribution complexity on top of heavily-penalized objective function causes parameter collapse. Simpler model + cleaner objective > complex model + multi-penalty stack.

failed_experiments.lesson: Single-model HMM cannot decouple vol regime from direction regime. State splitting (6→7→9) doesn't solve underlying misspecification.
